summary.text: Gemini 1.5 Pro is a mid-size multimodal model in Google's Gemini Pro line and the first model of the Gemini 1.5 generation, announced in February 2024 and built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Offered to developers through the Gemini API and Vertex AI, it takes text, images, audio and video, with a 128,000-token standard context window that later reached 2 million in the Gemini API.

changes.text: Uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, which Google says makes the model more efficient to train and serve.
Standard context window grows from 32,000 to 128,000 tokens, with up to 1 million in private preview and 2 million generally available in the Gemini API from June 2024.
Accepts audio (speech) and video alongside text and images; at API launch Gemini 1.0 Pro took text only, with images through the separate Pro Vision endpoint.
Google says 1.5 Pro reaches quality comparable to 1.0 Ultra while using less compute.

notes: First model of the Gemini 1.5 generation, built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. The record covers the February 2024 preview and the first stable version gemini-1.5-pro-001; the September 2024 update gemini-1.5-pro-002 is a separate record (google.gemini-1-5-pro-002). Later versions of the technical report describe an updated 1.5 Pro and compare it with the February version. Retirement: the generic gemini-1.5-pro model was shut down in the Gemini API on 2025-09-29; Vertex AI retired gemini-1.5-pro-001 on 2025-05-24. Prominence standard because 1.5 is a point version, although Google calls it a next-generation model.
